segments.t: Just before leaving for work, Kostya realizes he forgot to pack fruit for his son and asks Max to cover for him with Nastya, even while lecturing Max about honesty in marriage.
Не говори, что я забыл фрукты.
Let's break down each line of Kostya and Max's exchange about family secrets.
'I forgot the fruit.' Because he forgot the fruit, Kostya treats the matter as settled.
'Do you have any fruit?' Checking whether Max has any fruit is how Kostya puts Max on the spot.
'We do not have any fruit.' Max mentions that they do not have any fruit so Kostya sees what is at stake. Russian expresses having something as "by me is", keeping the phrase short and grounded.
'Do not tell Nastya.' Claiming that do not tell Nastya sounds confident, even if Max has doubts. Using the informal "you" shows how direct and unfiltered their kitchen relationship is.
Не говори, что я забыл фрукты.
'Do not say that I forgot the fruit.' Pointing out that do not say that he forgot the fruit gives Max a sobering reality check.
'And I will say that I brought them.' Kostya explains that he will say that he brought them, keeping his voice calm and direct.
'Bro, thanks for helping us out.' Realizing that bro thanks for helping them out changes how Kostya handles the situation.
'Come on, everything is fine.' Coming on everything is fine is how Max lays out the situation for Kostya.
'Only Vika is angry at me.' Even though only Vika is angry at him, Max keeps a steady face in front of Kostya.

'Children bring people closer, right?' With the situation and work hanging in the air, Kostya puts Max on the spot. In Russian, he does not need helper words like "do" or "did"—rising pitch alone turns it into a question.
'In a family you must tell the truth.' Saying that in a family Max must tell the truth is how Kostya sets the tone with Max.

'Like you with the fruit, right?' With the situation and moment hanging in the air, Max puts Kostya on the spot. Using the informal "you" shows how direct and unfiltered their kitchen relationship is.
'All right, call me if anything happens.' Adding that all right call him if anything happens fills in the missing piece for Max.
'Our Stepan is calm.' Saying that their Stepan is calm is how Kostya sets the tone with Max.
'There will be no problems with him.' Since there will be no problems with him, Kostya does not waste words on excuses. Now listen to the entire conversation again at full speed.
Не говори, что я забыл фрукты.
Notice how Kostya uses the two-word phrase meaning 'if anything comes up' right before heading out the door. Until next time!
